title: litellm not declared for uv tool install
description:
## Problem

After `uv tool install --from . kanbus`, JIT/standup fail with `litellm is required for right-now summary generation`. Manual `uv pip install --python <tool-env> litellm` unblocks.

## Fix

Declare litellm (and any other AI-stack deps needed for `kbs now` / `kbs standup`) in package deps. Curated fail-closed stderr (clear Kanbus message, not raw litellm traceback).

## Acceptance

Clean `uv tool install` on fresh env; `kbs now` / `kbs standup` work without manual litellm side-install.
